in_marathi.name: Nehansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of New Beginnings
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nehansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neha' meaning new, and 'Ansh' meaning soul. The name 'Nehansh' represents the Lord who brings new beginnings in life.

in_bengali.name: Nehansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of New Beginnings
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nehansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neha' meaning new, and 'Ansh' meaning soul. The name 'Nehansh' represents the Lord who brings new beginnings in life.
